entities.name: Alfred Frank Millidge
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfred Frank Millidge was a British arachnologist who specialised in the spider family Linyphiidae. He co-authored the influential three-volume work British Spiders with G. H. Locket and conducted extensive taxonomic research on North American and South American linyphiid spiders.
